basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old graphic designer based in Warsaw, Poland. Passionate about gaming, especially open-world and RPG titles like Cyberpunk 2077. Enjoys creating wallpapers and digital art, often using Wallpaper Engine to share creations with others. A night owl who typically browses Reddit during late evenings and weekends. Currently single, spending most free time gaming, reading about design, and exploring visual storytelling. Loves the futuristic aesthetic and often finds inspiration in cyberpunk themes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a degree in Graphic Design from the Warsaw Academy of Fine Arts. Self-taught skills in digital art tools like Photoshop and Blender. Regularly follows online tutorials and participates in workshops to keep skills sharp. Deep interest in game design principles and futuristic art styles acquired through years of gaming and online community interactions.
